rule: The decisive solution obtains one algebraic/discriminant result and then applies a distinct coefficient, parameter, degree, or integer filter. This is sequential use of results, not mutually dependent concepts; a single primary L3 does not erase the actual chained steps.

The first repeated-root discriminant determines n from m; the second distinct-root discriminant and card range then filter the ordered pairs.
